system.description: This bolt of fine, silky fabric is wrapped around a person’s body. On command, fabric of style turns into a any sort of outfit of excellent quality, but does not include accessories like jewelry, watches, and so forth. Fabric of style also grants a +2 equipment bonus on @Check[ability:cha]{Charisma check}s and Charisma-based skill checks while worn. The style of outfit can be changed, but the fabric of style must be removed and donned again, requiring a full-round action. If any part of the outfit is removed, the fabric of style turns back into the bolt of cloth.
